The '''Rock Hound''' was a four-legged [[Canine/Legends|canine]] species found inside caves in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] desert.<ref name="NP">{{StoryCite|story=Star Wars (article)|book=Wikipedia:Nintendo Power|bformatted=''Nintendo Power'' Vol. 28|sformatted=''Star Wars''}}</ref> The creatures burrowed into nearby rocks and would burst to the surface to attack an enemy.<ref name="SWNES">[[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game (1991)]]</ref> A number of the canines inhabited a cave known as the [[Rock Hounds' Lair]].<ref name="NP" />

==Behind the scenes==
These creatures first appearing in the [[1991]] [[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game]] were unnamed in the game itself. An [[Star Wars (article)|article]] in an issue of [[Wikipedia:Nintendo Power|''Nintendo Power'']] referred to them as Rock Hounds. In the instruction manual and ''[[Star Wars Hint Book]]'', however, they were erroneously referred to as [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]].
